prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Milestone", "Scroll to review your companion's details and finalize adoption."]
2: ["Interacting With Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open the interaction menu, feed, or change pet behavior.", "Click and drag to move your pet across screens."]
3: ["Quick Desktop Controls Practice", "Learn how to easily summon or minimize your companion whenever you need focused workspace.", "Double-click tray icon to toggle pet visibility"]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Companion", "Choose a fast authentication method to link your pet to your account."]
5: ["Setting Up Desktop Workspace", "Preparing graphics engine and loading pet animations for your screen...", "Initializing desktop display overlay"]
6: ["Always Accessible in Your System Tray", "Find your pet's menu icon in the system tray to access settings, hide the pet, or mute desktop sounds.", "System Tray Active"]
7: ["Crafting Your Companion", "Generating companion traits, desktop behaviors, and sound effects.", "Step 1 of 3: Building pet graphics..."]
8: ["For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos facing directly at the camera."]
9: ["Choose How to Begin", "Select a ready-to-adopt starter companion or build a custom pet from your own photos."]

verdicts.problem: asks for personal information by requesting photos of the user facing the camera
